name: Mudsprocket
summary: Mudsprocket is a remote goblin outpost huddled in the southwestern reaches of Dustwallow Marsh. Tied politically and economically to Gadgetzan, this swampy settlement serves as a neutral haven for travelers skirting the dangerous dragonkins' lairs and ogre ruins nearby.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Muck
sections.body: Perched on the rim of the sunken wetlands near Thousand Needles, Mudsprocket provides a remarkably civilized pocket of trade amid hostile wilderness. Operated under the aegis of the Steamwheedle Cartel through Gadgetzan, the outpost features a functioning laboratory, inn, and transport depot. Goblins here care little about the factional friction between Theramore and Brackenwall Village; instead, their primary concerns are profit, research, and keeping the local marsh fauna from chewing through their delicate machinery.

sections.title: Surrounded by Peril
sections.body: The settlement's strategic placement is as dangerous as it is lucrative. Sitting directly between the territory of the Black dragonflight to the east and the ruins of Stonemaul Hold to the north, Mudsprocket regularly contracts independent adventurers to handle threats. From collecting raptor plumage and containing local beasts to meddling directly in dragon business, the residents are happy to pay anyone willing to get their boots muddy.

faq.answer: Mudsprocket is run by goblins affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel, specifically managed under the jurisdiction of Gadgetzan. It operates as an entirely neutral outpost welcoming both Alliance and Horde travelers.

faq.q: Why did the goblins build a town out here?
aliases: why is mudsprocket in the swamp
faq.answer: Steamwheedle goblins established the outpost to exploit the region's resources, conduct uninterrupted laboratory experiments, and capitalize on travelers crossing between Dustwallow Marsh, Thousand Needles, and the Barrens.
The town is surrounded by raptors like Goreclaw, restless spirits wandering the fallen ruins of Stonemaul Hold, and the formidable brood of the Black dragonflight roosting in the marsh.

faq.q: Can members of both the Horde and Alliance safely visit?
faq.answer: Yes. Mudsprocket is completely neutral. Both Horde and Alliance adventurers can use its flight path, rest at the inn, repair armor, and take on local mercenary contracts.

angles.text: The goblin laboratory and on-site forge offer tinkerers a familiar, grease-stained haven to service gear deep within an otherwise unforgiving marsh.
For Horde travelers trekking between Brackenwall and southern Kalimdor, Mudsprocket offers a neutral respite free from direct Alliance oversight out of Theramore.
